crossSource.note: Word-level differences are Uthmani word-joining (بعدما / بعد ما) and hamza-carrier variants. 12:39 and 12:41 differ only in the traditional ى carrier used for the long ā in صىحبى.

translationCrossCheck.note: Remaining differences are edition wording and transliteration diacritics (e.g. Allah/Allāh).
